title: PhoneHarness：通过混合GUI、CLI和工具操作实现手机使用代理
summary: PhoneHarness是一个混合动作基准测试和执行框架，用于评估手机使用代理在可验证移动工作流上的表现。它结合了GUI、CLI和主机端工具动作，实现了75.0%的通过率，比最强基线高出12.9个百分点。研究表明，可靠的手机自动化依赖于动作表面路由和可验证执行，而不仅仅是视觉GUI控制。
summary_en: PhoneHarness is a mixed-action benchmark and execution harness for evaluating phone-use agents on verifiable mobile workflows. It combines GUI, CLI, and host-side tool actions, achieving a 75.0% pass rate, outperforming the strongest baseline by 12.9 percentage points. Findings suggest reliable phone automation depends on action-surface routing and verifiable execution, not only visual GUI control.
